headline: E-Commerce Marketing | Paid Media & Marketplaces | Content Analytics
headline_rationale: The cosmetics-commerce role needs paid media, Amazon, SEO/content and measurement. Use verified commerce/channel/marketplace experience and creative work; do not invent beauty experience, Korean language, influencer programs or scientific claims.
summary: E-commerce marketer experienced across paid media, marketplaces, content and conversion analysis. Managed Google, Amazon and paid social channels, developed Amazon marketplace strategies across Seller and Vendor Central, and worked with manufacturers on products and supply-chain processes. Combines SEO consulting, personalized web and email content, digital creative and KPI reporting with hands-on Shopify-connected website development. Agency strategy and financial analysis provide a practical foundation for evaluating promotions, channel investment and opportunities for profitable commerce growth.
factual_review: Read exact Jobgether Cosmetics/Ecommerce Digital Marketing Specialist posting including contractor compensation and US-hour coordination. E030/E056/E055/E044/E114/E109/E038/E001/E076/E063 support claims. No cosmetics/skincare vertical tenure, Korean proficiency, influencer results or microbiome expertise invented; existing canonical qualification thresholds unchanged.
tools_rationale: Actual supported advertising, marketplace, commerce and reporting tools relevant to multichannel retail execution.
